foundations: the canonical Action chain has tenant-scoped Proposal, Approval, ExecutionLease, immutable initial Receipt, unknown without blind retry, provider reread reconcile and compensation Proposal foundations
generic execution rejects R4 or execution-disabled policy snapshots unless a specialized policy is supplied
the generic frontend distinguishes approved, leased, executing, applied, failed, unknown and reconciled and disables disconnected writes
the reviewed price target contract separates research, match and monitoring readiness from notice, recommendation and repricing readiness

findings.finding: W6-05 has no implemented PriceCase, MonitoringPolicy or frozen research batch, so W6-06 has no valid price decision authority to consume.
no versioned price notice, internal recommendation, campaign handoff or repricing Action/Draft types are declared; ecommerce.price-governance permissions.actionTypes is empty.

no domain compiler or policy guarantees independent PriceCase-to-Draft/Impact/Approval/Lease paths for notice, recommendation and repricing; research readiness cannot be proven separate from write readiness.
no exact joint binding ties PriceCase, affected Product/SKU/orders, account, capability, policy, budget and ImpactPreview to the resulting Proposal and Lease.

the generic risk policy remains insufficient for price semantics; no versioned authority classifies internal recommendation, external notice, campaign suggestion and repricing by amount, scope, channel and rollback/compensation risk.

generic R4 rejection is a safe floor but no specialized repricing maker-checker, floor/MAP/margin/inventory/order-impact policy, account binding, canary or kill authority exists; repricing must remain disabled.
the production ActionAdapter registry has no typed notice or repricing adapter and no trusted account, dry validation, usage, webhook, partial or conformance contract.
the generic executor commits Lease consumption before provider invocation, retaining a crash-without-Receipt window; this is unacceptable for price notice or repricing.
resolved provider outcome is embedded in a reconciled payload rather than a directly aggregateable field, manual Case is absent and no price-specific compensation mapping or state reread exists.
no canonical minimal-ref Handoff maps PriceCase to content/activity, operations or customer modules with purpose, accept/reject/request-more Receipt and no copied competitor/customer payload.
only the generic Draft Inbox and common Workshop shell exist; no price-specific Impact, approval separation, repricing disabled state, partial/unknown timeline or intervention UI is implemented.
W5-00 through W5-08 are all unchecked and production adapter registrations remain zero, so no price external capability is code-green or operational-ready.

verification.interpretation: generic single-action safety and UI foundations are stable, while price notice, recommendation, handoff and repricing types, policies, adapters and read models are absent; repricing remains safely disabled
